• Have your laptop or tablet open to the Canvas page. The MLM test will 
appear there under Quizzes as “MLM1 - Attempt 2 (In Class)”
• Close you other windows/tabs and put away all other devices.
• Make sure your name and student ID are on your study sheet. This 
must be handed in at the end of the test. If you did not make a study 
sheet, then write your name/ID on a blank piece of paper.
• The Canvas test will be available at 9:05 am. Once you open it, you 
will have 15 minutes. The quiz window closes at 9:23 am.
• You must save and submit before your timer runs out. Answers that 
are not saved (ie. blank) will still be counted.
• Remain seated until the time is over. Please close laptops when you are 
done. You cannot use your devices while waiting, and cannot 
communicate with others, but you are welcome to do paper-based 
work.
Good luck!

Code Word: Chickadee

Learning Outcomes
Using a transport graph for a molecule, predict the type of transport 
occurring (and explain your reasoning in words, clearly connecting your 
explanation to data from a figure). To do this you will need to be able to:
• Recognize that movement of most molecules across membranes is mediated by 
proteins in the membrane.
• Recognize and describe membrane transport proteins (carriers versus channels) and 
list the differences between these types of proteins.
• Recognize and describe between the different types of membrane transport (simple 
diffusion, facilitated diffusion and active transport) in terms of concentration 
dependence, protein transporters, and energy requirements.
• Plot a transport graph comparing the concentration ratios of molecules across 
membranes over time.
• Distinguish between the processes of diffusion and osmosis.
